about: The Workbench icons of the Cannonball drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/cannonball.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a red open-top sports car racing down a coast road towards a low sun, palm trees beside it) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/cannonball.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Cannonball-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Cannonball.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Cannonball.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for LICENSE.txt, README-Cannonball.txt, Licences.txt and ROMs/roms.txt; Data.info is the Res, ROMs and User drawers' icon.
